name: v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha19
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha19

- cd changer: only the discs chosen in the file, the Osmium Sound disc for an album without a cover
- vu store: Titanium v6, a long needle from under the frame, no hub cover
- zones, bluetooth speakers: Lyrion forgets the player when it goes
- settings: Advanced Audio Tweaks, a section of its own for DSD, PCM to DSD and squeezelite
- system disk: a reserve Lyrion can always write into, so a full disk no longer breaks it
- web admin: no "Add one below" under an empty sources list, there is nothing below it there
- now playing: a larger format chip with the plate's ">", it opens the signal path
- now playing: the signal path, from the file to what the DAC is really fed
- manual: play from a NAS instead of a Windows PC
- manual: shared folders with Windows and Mac, and signing in to streaming services
- vu store: Blue Neon v2, the meter sits higher in Now Playing
- vu store: Blue Neon, a backlit neon meter
